title: Currency conversion loses its unsupported-currency check

text:
app.get("/price/{sku}/converted")
 def converted_price(sku: str, currency: str

# What Went Wrong

Someone requested a price converted to a currency that didn't exist in the system, so the program tried to multiply a number by nothing, which broke it.

# What the Fix Changed

The system now checks whether the currency is valid before attempting the multiplication, and returns a clear error message instead of crashing.
